assumptions: The input PDFs contain extractable text (not scanned images requiring OCR).
The size of the extracted text fits within the context window of the LLM powering the agents.
The user provides a valid file path or accessible URL to a PDF paper.

agents.responsibility: Reads and parses PDF documents using extraction tools, and routes the extracted text to specialized agents in parallel to compile the final methodology and metric summary.
agents.name: ResearchCoordinatorAgent
agents.description: Coordinates the ingestion of technical PDFs and orchestrates specialized extraction agents to produce structured research reports.

agents.name: MethodologyExtractorAgent
agents.responsibility: Performs deep semantic analysis of the paper text to extract core algorithmic innovations, mathematical models, and architectural components, and formats them into a structured summary.
agents.description: Analyzes research paper text to extract, structure, and summarize key methodologies, algorithms, and architectures.
Analyzes research paper text to locate and extract quantitative benchmark datasets, evaluation metrics, and performance tables.
agents.responsibility: Scans the experimental and evaluation sections of the paper to extract key datasets used, baseline comparisons, metrics, and quantitative benchmark results, formatting them into structured data.
agents.name: BenchmarkExtractorAgent

project.description: An AI assistant to automatically digest technical research PDFs, summarize methodologies, and extract benchmark metrics.
project.name: research_assistant
project.goal: To automate the analysis of technical research papers by extracting core methodological innovations and structured benchmark metrics from ingested PDFs.
